pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through uneven edge budgeting. They over-contour with a dark, even-weight, closed line and detail every small form (planks, leaves, petals, bark, mesh) to the same hardness, so hero density exceeds the real ceiling and nothing is sharpest at a focus. Backgrounds are often outlined as hard as the hero. The opposite failure also appears on smooth objects: too few internal edges, with fuzzy ripples or a melting silhouette. Real cards use thin precise seams, sparse interiors, and a contour that thins or is lost on lit sides.
